name: OpenShelf Full Cycle
description: Full round-trip on the OpenShelf: pick a tipbox off the table and load it into the cabinet (store), then dispense that same item back out and receive it with the arm. Load first, retrieve second (pick_and_load followed by receive_openshelf).
author: zeon

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Item to run through the full cycle: stored into the OpenShelf, then dispensed back out (must match a stored item; sim uses canned 'Sim Item A' / 'Sim Item B').

nodes.label: Pick Up Tipbox
nodes.description: Right arm grabs the tipbox off the table (reach standoff, descend, eased close, attach, lift).

nodes.label: Carry Into OpenShelf
nodes.description: Carry the held tipbox to a standoff just outside the IO box, then ease straight -Y into the tight square (careful entry, mirror of retract).

nodes.label: Release Into OpenShelf
nodes.description: Push a bit deeper into the IO box (-Y), ease the gripper open, and detach the tipbox so it stays in the shelf.

nodes.label: Retract
nodes.description: Pull the arm straight out (+Y) so it clears the shelf, leaving the tipbox behind.

nodes.label: Load (Store API)
nodes.description: Call the OpenShelf store API to load the item into the cabinet (robot auto-assigns the cell). Sim returns canned success.

nodes.label: Go Home
nodes.description: Return the right arm to its stow pose.

nodes.label: Dispense From OpenShelf
nodes.description: Call the OpenShelf API to dispense the named object from the cabinet and present it at the plate anchor (embeds the snap); blocks until the cabinet physically finishes (~50s).

nodes.label: Reach OpenShelf
nodes.description: Right arm moves to the OpenShelf plate anchor where the item is presented.

nodes.label: Grab Item
nodes.description: Gradually close the right gripper on the item and attach it so it travels with the arm.

nodes.label: Back Out Of Box
nodes.description: Pull the arm (with the item) straight out of the IO box along +Y before homing, so it clears the shelf.

nodes.label: Place On Desk
nodes.description: Set the received tipbox down on the desk (anywhere): swing to the feasible pre-grasp branch over the bench, ease down, open the gripper, detach, and lift clear.

nodes.label: Carry Home
nodes.description: Return the right arm (holding the item) to its home rest pose.
